message: Find me a product that can help with my needs.
Enakku en needs-ku suitable product suggest pannunga.
Mujhe meri needs ke hisaab se product suggest karo.
Do you have this item available?
Indha item stock-la irukka?
Kya yeh item stock mein hai?
I'm looking for a specific product but can't find it.
Oru specific product theduren, aana kidaikkala.
Ek specific product dhoond raha hoon, lekin mil nahi raha.
Can you recommend something within my budget?
En budget-kulla oru product recommend pannunga.
Mere budget mein koi product recommend karo.
Which product would suit my requirements?
En requirements-ku endha product suit aagum?
Meri requirements ke liye kaunsa product sahi rahega?
Suggest an alternative to this product.
Indha product-ku alternative suggest pannunga.
Is product ka alternative suggest karo.
Is this product currently in stock?
Indha product ippo stock-la irukka?
Kya yeh product abhi stock mein hai?
Can I buy this item today?
Indha item-a innikku vaanga mudiyuma?
Kya main yeh item aaj khareed sakta hoon?
When will this item be available again?
Indha item thirumba eppo stock-ku varum?
Yeh item dobara stock mein kab aayega?
What is the current price of this item?
Indha item-oda current price enna?
Is item ki current price kya hai?
Has the price changed recently?
Indha product price recent-a change aacha?
Kya is product ka price recently badla hai?
Does the listed price include tax?
Listed price-la tax include aagirukka?
Listed price mein tax included hai kya?
What is the difference between these two products?
Indha rendu products-kum enna difference?
In dono products mein kya difference hai?
Which of these options has the features I need?
Enakku thevaiyana features endha option-la irukku?
Mujhe chahiye wale features kis option mein hain?
Compare the price and features for me.
Price-um features-um compare pannunga.
Price aur features compare karo.
What are the main specifications of this product?
Indha product-oda main specifications enna?
Is product ke main specifications kya hain?
How much storage does this model have?
Indha model-la evlo storage irukku?
Is model mein kitni storage hai?
Does this item support Bluetooth?
Indha item Bluetooth support pannuma?
Kya yeh item Bluetooth support karta hai?
Will this device work with my phone?
Indha device en phone-oda work aaguma?
Kya yeh device mere phone ke saath chalega?
Is this accessory compatible with my model?
Indha accessory en model-ku compatible-a?
Kya yeh accessory mere model ke saath compatible hai?
Can I connect this product to my laptop?
Indha product-a laptop-kku connect panna mudiyuma?
Kya main is product ko laptop se connect kar sakta hoon?
I want to cancel my order.
En order-a cancel pannanum.
Mujhe apna order cancel karna hai.
Please stop the order before it ships.
Ship aaguradhukku munnadi order-a stop pannunga.
Ship hone se pehle order rok do.
Can I cancel just one item from my order?
Order-la oru item mattum cancel panna mudiyuma?
Kya main order ka sirf ek item cancel kar sakta hoon?
I need to change the items in my order.
En order-la irukkura items change pannanum.
Mujhe apne order ke items change karne hain.
Can I add another item to my order?
En order-kku innum oru item add panna mudiyuma?
Kya main apne order mein ek aur item add kar sakta hoon?
I selected the wrong variant; can it be changed?
Wrong variant select panniten; change panna mudiyuma?
Maine galat variant select kiya; kya change ho sakta hai?
I placed an order but got no confirmation.
Order place panniten, aana confirmation varala.
Order place kiya, lekin confirmation nahi aaya.
There is no order confirmation in my email.
Email-la order confirmation illa.
Mere email mein order confirmation nahi hai.
I was charged but cannot see an order confirmation.
Amount debit aachu, order confirmation kaanom.
Paise kat gaye, par order confirmation nahi dikh raha.
What is the current status of my order?
En order status enna?
Mere order ka status kya hai?
Has my order been processed yet?
En order process aayiducha?
Kya mera order process ho gaya?
Can you check whether my order is confirmed?
En order confirm aachanu check pannunga.
Check karo mera order confirm hua hai ya nahi.
Where is my order right now?
En order ippo enga irukku?
Mera order abhi kahan hai?
Can you share the tracking update?
Tracking update share pannunga.
Tracking update share karo.
The tracking page has not changed.
Tracking page update aagala.
Tracking page update nahi hua.
How much is delivery for my address?
En address-ku delivery charge evlo?
Mere address par delivery charge kitna hai?
Why was a shipping fee added?
Shipping fee yen add pannirukkinga?
Shipping fee kyun add hui?
Is delivery free for this order?
Indha order-ku delivery free-a?
Kya is order ki delivery free hai?
My order is arriving later than promised.
Promise pannina date-a vida order late-a varudhu.
Mera order promised date se late aa raha hai.
The delivery date keeps changing.
Delivery date thirumba thirumba change aagudhu.
Delivery date baar baar change ho rahi hai.
My package has not arrived yet.
En package innum varala.
Mera package abhi tak nahi aaya.
It says delivered, but I haven't received it.
Delivered-nu kaattudhu, aana enakku kidaikkala.
Delivered dikha raha hai, lekin mujhe mila nahi.
The parcel is not at my door.
Parcel en veettu vaasal-la illa.
Parcel mere darwaze par nahi hai.
Can you investigate a missing package?
Missing package-a check pannunga.
Missing package ki jaanch karo.
I need to update the shipping address.
Shipping address update pannanum.
Shipping address update karna hai.
I entered the wrong address; can you help?
Wrong address enter panniten; help pannunga.
Maine galat address dala; help karo.
Can I change the address after ordering?
Order pannadhukku appuram address change panna mudiyuma?
Order ke baad address change kar sakta hoon?
What delivery options do you offer?
Neenga enna delivery options kudukkureenga?
Aap kaun-kaun se delivery options dete ho?
Is express delivery available?
Express delivery available-a?
Kya express delivery available hai?
Can I choose a delivery time?
Delivery time choose panna mudiyuma?
Kya main delivery time choose kar sakta hoon?
Which payment methods can I use?
Endha payment methods use pannalaam?
Kaun se payment methods use kar sakta hoon?
Do you accept UPI payments?
UPI payment accept pannuveengala?
Kya aap UPI payment accept karte ho?
Can I pay by card or cash on delivery?
Card illa cash on delivery-la pay pannalaama?
Card ya cash on delivery se pay kar sakta hoon?
My payment failed but the amount is showing as pending.
Payment fail aachu, amount pending-nu kaattudhu.
Payment fail hua, amount pending dikh raha hai.
The checkout says payment unsuccessful.
Checkout-la payment unsuccessful-nu varudhu.
Checkout mein payment unsuccessful aa raha hai.
I cannot complete the payment.
Payment complete panna mudiyala.
Main payment complete nahi kar paa raha hoon.
Money was deducted, but my order was not placed.
Amount debit aachu, aana order place aagala.
Paise kat gaye, lekin order place nahi hua.
UPI says successful but the order is missing.
UPI successful-nu varudhu, aana order kaanom.
UPI successful hai, lekin order nahi dikh raha.
My bank shows the charge, but there is no order.
Bank-la amount debit aagirukku, order illa.
Bank mein amount kata hai, par order nahi hai.
I think I was charged twice for one order.
Oru order-ku rendu thadava amount debit aayirukku.
Ek order ke liye do baar paise kat gaye.
The same payment appears two times.
Same payment rendu thadava kaattudhu.
Same payment do baar dikh raha hai.
Can you check this duplicate charge?
Indha duplicate charge-a check pannunga.
Is duplicate charge ko check karo.
What is your refund policy?
Ungal refund policy enna?
Aapki refund policy kya hai?
Am I eligible for a refund on this item?
Indha item-ku refund kidaikkuma?
Kya is item par refund mil sakta hai?
How many days do I have to request a refund?
Refund request panna ethana days irukku?
Refund request karne ke liye kitne din hain?
I want to request a refund.
Enakku refund venum; request pannunga.
Mujhe refund chahiye; request raise karo.
Please refund my returned item.
Return panna item-ku refund pannunga.
Returned item ka refund kar do.
The product is defective; I want my money back.
Product defect-a irukku; money back venum.
Product defective hai; mujhe paise wapas chahiye.
Has my refund been processed?
En refund process aayiducha?
Mera refund process ho gaya kya?
When will the refund reach my account?
Refund en account-ku eppo varum?
Refund mere account mein kab aayega?
I have not received the refund update.
Refund update innum varala.
Refund ka update abhi tak nahi aaya.
My item arrived damaged.
En item damage-a vandhirukku.
Mera item damaged aaya hai.
The box was broken when delivered.
Delivery time-la box odanjirundhuchu.
Delivery ke time box toota hua tha.
I received a cracked product.
Crack irukkura product vandhirukku.
Mujhe cracked product mila hai.
The product does not work properly.
Product correct-a work aagala.
Product sahi se kaam nahi kar raha.
It stopped working after I switched it on.
On pannadhum work aagala.
On karte hi kaam nahi kiya.
The device keeps restarting.
Device thirumba thirumba restart aagudhu.
Device baar baar restart ho raha hai.
I want to return this item.
Indha item-a return pannanum.
Mujhe yeh item return karna hai.
How do I start a return?
Return eppadi start pannanum?
Return kaise start karun?
Can you arrange a pickup for my return?
Return pickup arrange pannuveengala?
Mere return ke liye pickup arrange kar sakte ho?
Can I exchange this for another size?
Idha vera size-ku exchange panna mudiyuma?
Kya ise doosre size mein exchange kar sakta hoon?
I want a different colour instead.
Enakku vera colour venum; exchange pannunga.
Mujhe doosra colour chahiye; exchange kar do.
How can I exchange this item?
Indha item-a eppadi exchange pannalaam?
Is item ko exchange kaise karun?
I cannot log in to my account.
En account-la login panna mudiyala.
Main apne account mein login nahi kar paa raha hoon.
The app says my login details are incorrect.
Login details incorrect-nu app kaattudhu.
App login details incorrect dikha raha hai.
I keep getting logged out.
Thirumba thirumba logout aagudhu.
Mujhe baar baar logout kar raha hai.
I forgot my password.
Password marandhuten.
Main password bhool gaya hoon.
How do I reset my password?
Password reset eppadi pannanum?
Password reset kaise karun?
The password reset link is not working.
Password reset link work aagala.
Password reset link kaam nahi kar raha.
I have not received the OTP.
OTP innum varala.
OTP abhi tak nahi aaya.
The verification code is delayed.
Verification code late-a varudhu.
Verification code late aa raha hai.
I requested a code but got nothing.
Code request panninen, aana varala.
Code request kiya, lekin aaya nahi.
My account is locked.
En account lock aayiduchu.
Mera account lock ho gaya hai.
I cannot access my account after several attempts.
Neraya try panniyum account access panna mudiyala.
Kai attempts ke baad bhi account access nahi ho raha.
How can I unlock my account?
Account unlock eppadi pannanum?
Account unlock kaise karun?
I am unhappy with the service I received.
Neenga kudutha service-la enakku satisfaction illa.
Mujhe mili service se main khush nahi hoon.
I have had a bad experience with this order.
Indha order-la enakku bad experience.
Is order ke saath mera experience kharab raha.
I want to raise a complaint.
Complaint raise pannanum.
Mujhe complaint raise karni hai.
My issue has still not been resolved.
En problem innum solve aagala.
Meri problem abhi tak solve nahi hui.
I contacted support earlier, but nothing changed.
Already support-a contact panninen, aana change illa.
Pehle support se baat ki, lekin kuch change nahi hua.
This is the third time I am reporting this.
Idhu third time indha problem report panren.
Main teesri baar yeh problem report kar raha hoon.
I want to speak to a human agent.
Human agent kitta pesanum.
Mujhe human agent se baat karni hai.
Please connect me with a real person.
Oru real person-kitta connect pannunga.
Mujhe kisi real person se connect karo.
I do not want to talk to a bot.
Bot-kitta pesa virumbala.
Mujhe bot se baat nahi karni.
I think this message is a scam.
Indha message scam-nu thonudhu.
Mujhe lagta hai yeh message scam hai.
Someone sent me a suspicious payment link.
Suspicious payment link anuppirukkanga.
Kisi ne suspicious payment link bheja hai.
A seller is asking me to pay outside the platform.
Platform-ku veliya pay panna seller kekkuranga.
Seller platform ke bahar payment maang raha hai.
I do not recognize this transaction.
Indha transaction enakku theriyadhu.
Yeh transaction mujhe pehchaan mein nahi aa raha.
There is a payment I did not make.
Naan pannadha payment kaattudhu.
Aisi payment dikh rahi hai jo maine nahi ki.
Please help me report an unauthorized charge.
Unauthorized charge report panna help pannunga.
Unauthorized charge report karne mein help karo.
How do you use my personal data?
En personal data-a eppadi use panreenga?
Aap mera personal data kaise use karte ho?
Can I know what information you store?
Neenga enna information store panreenga-nu therinjukkalama?
Aap kaunsi information store karte ho?
Where can I read your privacy policy?
Privacy policy enga irukku?
Privacy policy kahan milegi?
I want to cancel my subscription.
En subscription-a cancel pannanum.
Mujhe apna subscription cancel karna hai.
Please stop the automatic renewal.
Auto renewal stop pannunga.
Automatic renewal band kar do.
I no longer want this membership.
Indha membership inime venam.
Mujhe ab yeh membership nahi chahiye.
My reward points have not been added.
En reward points add aagala.
Mere reward points add nahi hue.
Points are missing after my purchase.
Purchase pannadhukku appuram points kaanom.
Purchase ke baad points nahi dikh rahe.
Can you check my missing loyalty points?
Missing loyalty points check pannunga.
Mere missing loyalty points check karo.
Hello, I need some help.
Hi, enakku konjam help venum.
Hi, mujhe thodi help chahiye.
Good morning, can you help me?
Good morning, help pannuveengala?
Good morning, kya aap meri help kar sakte ho?
Hey there!
Hi macha, help venum.
Hey, mujhe help chahiye.
Thank you for resolving this.
Problem solve pannadhukku thanks.
Meri problem solve karne ke liye thanks.
Thanks for your help.
Help pannadhukku nandri.
Help karne ke liye shukriya.
I appreciate your support.
Unga support-ku romba thanks.
Aapki support ke liye bahut shukriya.
That thing is not working, please help.
Adhu work aagala, help pannunga.
Woh kaam nahi kar raha, help karo.
I need help with it.
Adhukku help venum.
Uske liye help chahiye.
It's still the same.
Innum adhe problem dhaan.
Abhi bhi wahi problem hai.
Please reply in Tamil.
Tamil-la reply pannunga.
Tamil mein reply karo.
Can you explain in simple English?
Simple English-la explain pannunga.
Simple English mein samjhao.
Please continue in Hindi.
Hindi-la continue pannunga.
Hindi mein baat karo.
I received a different product from the one I ordered.
Order panna product-ku badhila vera product vandhirukku.
Jo product order kiya tha uski jagah doosra product aaya.
This is not the item I selected.
Naan select panna item idhu illa.
Yeh woh item nahi hai jo maine select kiya tha.
Please help me report the wrong item.
Wrong item vandhadhai report panna help pannunga.
Galat item aane ki complaint karne mein help karo.
One item is missing from my package.
Package-la oru item missing.
Mere package mein ek item missing hai.
I ordered three things but received only two.
Moonu items order panninen, rendu dhaan vandhuchu.
Maine teen items order kiye, lekin do hi mile.
The package was open and an item was missing.
Package open-a irundhuchu, oru item kaanom.
Package khula tha aur ek item missing tha.
Please arrange a pickup for my return.
En return-ku pickup arrange pannunga.
Mere return ke liye pickup arrange karo.
When will the returned item be collected?
Return item-a eppo pickup pannuveenga?
Returned item kab pickup hoga?
I need to change my return pickup date.
Return pickup date change pannanum.
Return pickup ki date change karni hai.
I want to make a warranty claim.
Warranty claim panna venum.
Mujhe warranty claim karna hai.
My product is still under warranty but has stopped working.
Warranty irukkumbodhe product work aagala.
Warranty ke andar product kaam karna band ho gaya.
What documents are needed for a warranty claim?
Warranty claim-ku enna documents venum?
Warranty claim ke liye kaun se documents chahiye?
My promo code is not working.
Promo code work aagala.
Mera promo code kaam nahi kar raha.
The coupon says invalid at checkout.
Checkout-la coupon invalid-nu varudhu.
Checkout par coupon invalid dikha raha hai.
Why is my discount code not applying?
Discount code yen apply aagala?
Mera discount code apply kyun nahi ho raha?
There is an extra charge on my bill.
Bill-la extra charge irukku.
Mere bill mein extra charge hai.
I do not understand this fee.
Indha fee enna-nu puriyala.
Mujhe yeh fee samajh nahi aa rahi.
Please explain this additional amount.
Indha extra amount-a explain pannunga.
Yeh extra amount explain karo.
I need to change the email on my account.
Account email address change pannanum.
Mujhe account ka email address change karna hai.
I no longer use my registered email.
Registered email-a ippo use panradhu illa.
Main ab registered email use nahi karta.
How can I update my email address?
Email address eppadi update pannanum?
Email address kaise update karun?
I want to update my phone number.
Phone number update pannanum.
Mujhe phone number update karna hai.
My old number is no longer active.
En old number ippo active illa.
Mera purana number ab active nahi hai.
Can I change the mobile number linked to my account?
Account-oda linked mobile number change pannalama?
Account se linked mobile number change kar sakta hoon?
I get an error when I try to check out.
Checkout panna try pannumbodhu error varudhu.
Checkout karte waqt error aa raha hai.
The place-order button does not work.
Place-order button work aagala.
Place-order button kaam nahi kar raha.
I cannot move to the payment page.
Payment page-ku pogave mudiyala.
Main payment page par nahi ja paa raha.
The app closes whenever I open it.
App open pannumbodhu close aagudhu.
App kholte hi band ho jaata hai.
The app keeps crashing on my phone.
En phone-la app thirumba thirumba crash aagudhu.
Mere phone par app baar baar crash ho raha hai.
I cannot use the app because it shuts down.
App shutdown aaguradhunaala use panna mudiyala.
App band ho jaata hai, isliye use nahi kar paa raha.
I am not receiving order notifications.
Order notifications varala.
Order notifications nahi aa rahe.
The app does not send alerts anymore.
App alerts ippo anuppuradhu illa.
App ab alerts nahi bhej raha.

Notifications eppadi on pannanum?
Notifications kaise on karun?
Please escalate this complaint to a supervisor.
Indha complaint-a supervisor-kku escalate pannunga.
Is complaint ko supervisor tak escalate karo.
I need someone senior to review this issue.
Indha issue-a senior person review pannanum.
Is issue ko senior person se review karwana hai.
I am not satisfied with the response; please escalate it.
Response-la satisfaction illa; escalate pannunga.
Response se satisfied nahi hoon; escalate karo.

Unga supervisor-kitta pesalama?
Kya main aapke supervisor se baat kar sakta hoon?
Please connect me to a manager.
Manager-kitta connect pannunga.
Mujhe manager se connect karo.
I want a senior support representative.
Senior support representative venum.
Mujhe senior support representative chahiye.
I think someone accessed my account without permission.
Permission illaama yaaro en account access pannirukkaanga-nu thonudhu.
Mujhe lagta hai kisi ne bina permission mera account access kiya.
I received a login alert that was not mine.
Naan login pannala, aana login alert vandhuchu.
Maine login nahi kiya, phir bhi login alert aaya.
Please help me secure my account.
En account-a secure panna help pannunga.
Mera account secure karne mein help karo.
Please stop sending me promotional messages.
Promotional messages anuppuradha stop pannunga.
Promotional messages bhejna band karo.

Marketing emails-la irundhu unsubscribe aaganum.
Marketing emails se unsubscribe karna hai.

Promotions-la irundhu opt out eppadi pannanum?
Promotions se opt out kaise karun?

Indha service-ku eppadi subscribe pannanum?
Is service ko subscribe kaise karun?
I want to start a membership.
Membership start pannanum.
Mujhe membership start karni hai.

Enna subscription plans available-a irukku?
Kaun se subscription plans available hain?

Customer support-a eppadi contact pannanum?
Customer support se contact kaise karun?
Please share the official support contact.
Official support contact share pannunga.
Official support contact share karo.
I need help from the customer service team.
Customer service team-kitta help venum.
Mujhe customer service team se help chahiye.
